lemma aux_comul_antipode [CommSemiring C] [HopfAlgebra R C] [IsCocomm R C] :

  let S := antipodeAlgHom R C

  let d : WithConv (C →ₐ[R] C ⊗[R] C) := toConv Δ
  let k1 : WithConv (C →ₐ[R] C ⊗[R] C) := toConv (Δ.comp S)
  let k2 : WithConv (C →ₐ[R] C ⊗[R] C) := toConv (S2.comp Δ)

      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift f g (fun _ _ => Commute.all _ _) t
        = LinearMap.mul' R (C ⊗[R] C) (TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap g.toLinearMap t) := by
    intro f g t
    induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul x y => simp
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  have hmul : LinearMap.mul' R (C ⊗[R] C) ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map Δ.toLinearMap Δ.toLinearMap
      = Δ.toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.mul' R C := by
    ext x y; simp
  have hcc : TensorProduct.map Δ.toLinearMap Δ.toLinearMap ∘ₗ Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := C)
      = Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := C ⊗[R] C) ∘ₗ Δ.toLinearMap :=
    (comulCoalgHom R C).map_comp_comul
  have hcounit : Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := C ⊗[R] C) ∘ₗ Δ.toLinearMap
      = Coalgebra.counit :=
    (comulCoalgHom R C).counit_comp
  have h1 : k1 * d = 1 := by
    ext c
    simp only [k1, d, AlgHom.convMul_apply, hlift]
    have e1 : LinearMap.mul' R C (LinearMap.rTensor C (antipode R) (Coalgebra.comul c))
        = algebraMap R C (Coalgebra.counit c) :=
      LinearMap.congr_fun (HopfAlgebra.mul_antipode_rTensor_comul (R := R) (A := C)) c
    have e3 : ∀ t, LinearMap.mul' R (C ⊗[R] C) (TensorProduct.map Δ.toLinearMap Δ.toLinearMap t)
        = Δ (LinearMap.mul' R C t) := fun t => LinearMap.congr_fun hmul t
    have hm : TensorProduct.map (Δ.toLinearMap ∘ₗ S.toLinearMap) Δ.toLinearMap
        = TensorProduct.map Δ.toLinearMap Δ.toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor C S.toLinearMap := by
      ext x y; simp
    rw [AlgHom.comp_toLinearMap, hm, LinearMap.comp_apply, e3]
    have e1' : LinearMap.mul' R C (LinearMap.rTensor C S.toLinearMap (Coalgebra.comul c))
        = algebraMap R C (Coalgebra.counit c) := e1
    rw [e1']
    simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply]
  have h2 : d * k2 = 1 := by
    ext c
    simp only [k2, d, AlgHom.convMul_apply, hlift]
    have e1 : LinearMap.mul' R (C ⊗[R] C) (LinearMap.lTensor (C ⊗[R] C) S2.toLinearMap
        (Coalgebra.comul (Δ c))) = algebraMap R (C ⊗[R] C) (Coalgebra.counit (Δ c)) :=

    have hm : TensorProduct.map Δ.toLinearMap (S2.toLinearMap ∘ₗ Δ.toLinearMap)

    have e2 : (TensorProduct.map Δ.toLinearMap Δ.toLinearMap) (Coalgebra.comul c)

    have e4 : Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (Δ c) = Coalgebra.counit c := LinearMap.congr_fun hcounit c
    rw [AlgHom.comp_toLinearMap, hm, LinearMap.comp_apply, e2, e1, e4]
    simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply]
  have : k1 = k2 := by
    calc k1 = k1 * (d * k2) := by rw [h2, mul_one]
      _ = k2 := by rw [← mul_assoc, h1, one_mul]
  have := congrArg (fun f => (ofConv f).toLinearMap) this
  exact this

    let S := antipodeAlgHom R C

      rw [AlgHom.convMul_def]
      congr 1
      have h : (Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' R).comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.map i1 i2)
          = AlgHom.id R (C ⊗[R] C) := by
        apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext <;> ext <;> simp [i1, i2]
      rw [← AlgHom.comp_assoc, h]
      rfl
    have he : toConv ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map S S).comp (comulAlgHom R C))
        = toConv (i1.comp S) * toConv (i2.comp S) := by
      rw [AlgHom.convMul_def]
      congr 1
      have h : (Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' R).comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (i1.comp S) (i2.comp S))
          = (Algebra.TensorProduct.map S S) := by
        apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext <;> ext <;> simp [i1, i2]
      rw [← AlgHom.comp_assoc, h]
    have key : toConv ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map S S).comp (comulAlgHom R C))
        = toConv ((comulAlgHom R C).comp S) := by
      rw [he]
      have h1 : toConv (i1.comp S) = (toConv i1)⁻¹ := rfl
      have h2 : toConv (i2.comp S) = (toConv i2)⁻¹ := rfl
      have h3 : toConv ((comulAlgHom R C).comp S) = (toConv (comulAlgHom R C))⁻¹ := rfl
      rw [h1, h2, h3, hd, mul_inv]
    have key' := congrArg (fun f => f.ofConv.toLinearMap) key
    exact key'

instance : Inv (WithConv <| C →ₐc[R] A) where inv f := toConv <| f.ofConv.comp antipodeBialgHom
